blind.description: A stylised fantasy pylon or pedestal consisting of a dark grey-green stone base tapering upward, wrapped with a brass or bronze metallic collar/band around its midsection. At the top sits a square stone/metal bracket holding a cluster of faceted amber or golden glowing crystals pointing upward. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized low-poly/hand-painted style, with no floating shards or defects. The underside rests flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A square footprint showing the darker stepped base perimeter, with a cluster of faceted pointed golden crystals clustered in the center surrounded by four corner brackets.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 feet tall), with a footprint about 1 to 1.5 feet square.
